semantics.what: Declared release-transaction phase for @holaxis/aslite. Read by scripts/release-audit-tags.mjs (npm run release:audit-tags), which computes the expected npm dist-tag state for this phase and fails CI when the live registry disagrees. Two authorities compose there and neither restates the other: scripts/release-state.mjs resolveTags owns the phase machine, and release/targets.json owns which dist-tags a version may ever carry (a tuple's npm_tag plus npm_promote_tag). Declaring a phase that would place a version on a dist-tag its tuple never gives it is itself a violation.
semantics.phase: One of at_rest | staged | approved | promoted | failed. An absent file means at_rest. At rest before 0.1.0, each dist-tag rests on the newest published prerelease ELIGIBLE for it under release/targets.json — latest == next == newest published for versions the manifest does not constrain, but a candidate the manifest publishes to next only leaves latest where it is.
semantics.kind: Required outside at_rest: prerelease | stable — the kind of the in-flight release transaction. null at rest.
semantics.version: Required outside at_rest: the exact candidate version the transaction is about. null at rest.
semantics.lifecycle: Changing this file is a reviewed commit. Flip it to staged in the release-preparation PR, advance it through the transaction, and return it to at_rest only once the registry reflects the settled tag state. After a post-approval failure, stay in failed until the replacement release restores latest == next == newest supported.
